body.x: The BeeWi products announced today its Wi-Fi "Mars Rover" Camera Buggy, MINI Cooper, Combat Helicopters & AirPlay-killer streaming device at the 2013 International Consumer Electronics show (CES) from January 8-11, 2013.
Scara Bee, a "Mars Rover" like Wi-Fi buggy with an integrated video camera
The iconic MINI Cooper bluetooth controlled for iOS/Android devices
Sting Bee, the only real combat helicopter that let's you fight against another helicopter, also bluetooth and for iOS/Android devices
